main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (minus same coin/window mean forward 5-bar return), non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm: negative with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 of the 3 coins; reject: positive with t >= +2; inconclusive otherwise or fewer than 30 pooled cases

supporting_check.name: sign of excess return per coin (negative in at least 2 coins)

decided_by: t lies strictly between -2 and +2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Extreme cases are grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... of each window) with forecast <= -10 and a 5-bar forward return inside the window, the baseline is the mean 5-bar forward return over all bars of that coin and window that have one, the t is the ordinary t of the pooled mean, and 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' is applied literally as at least 2 coins with negative mean excess return among the coins present.
